thread:
maria: Heads up — noticed a spike in inbound leads not getting assigned + missing enrichment tags (company_size / industry). Funnels show ~23 leads stuck this morning. Any ideas? @aj :eyes:
aj: Looking into it. I see round-robin is skipping reps marked 'out_of_office' but there are several active reps who also didn't get assigned.
sam: FYI the enrichment lambda errored on 2026-03-21 09:12 — got a 429 from Clearbit. We’re falling back to partial enrichment but our assignment rules depend on company_size so those leads are left ownerless.
devon: Can we fallback to a regional queue when enrichment is missing? Sales prefers round-robin only for fully enriched leads.
aj: Proposed quick fix: update HubSpot workflow to set Owner = 'oz_inbound_queue' when enrichment.status != "complete" OR enrichment.api_error = true. Then run a nightly enrichment reattempt and reassign if enriched. Quick condition I’ll add: ```if (properties.enrichment_status != 'complete' || enrichment_error == true) { owner = 'oz_inbound_queue' }```
maria: Sounds good. Also we need a handoff SLA — currently not tracked. Recommend 15-min initial-touch SLA for MQLs, escalate after 30m to CS lead. Can we add this to the playbook and surface it in HubSpot reports?
devon: I’ll add to the Playbook and create a Salesforce assignment rule as a safety net: when Lead.Source = Website AND HubSpotOwner IS NULL THEN assign to Inbound Queue OwnerId=00Gxx000000XXXX.
aj: I’ll push the HS workflow change now (minor workflow edit). Deploying automation — ping me if you see duplicates.
leadflow-bot: Workflow 'Inbound - Enrichment fallback' updated by aj at 2026-03-21T09:45:12Z :white_check_mark:
sam: Reattempt job scheduled in 30 mins. If Clearbit rate limits persist we should flip to enrichment-provider-b as fallback; will open a ticket with SRE for quota bump.
maria: Please also add a custom property 'handoff_sla_minutes' in HubSpot so BI can report Time-to-Owner.
aj: Done — property added: handoff_sla_minutes. I’ll wire it into Looker dashboard (inbound_leads -> time_to_owner). cc @devon for SF mapping.
devon: Connector mapping updated. I’ll run a test lead through in ~10m.
aj: Test lead created: https://app.hubspot.com/leads/12345 — assigned to oz_inbound_queue (Owner NULL -> queue). :thumbsup:
maria: Great. If root cause is provider throttling someone should do a short postmortem and add mitigation steps to the Playbook. Assigning postmortem to @sam.
sam: Will do a brief write-up and link to Notion + this thread. I’ll include: timeline, error logs, mitigation (queue fallback), SLA decision, and follow-ups (quota / alt provider).

ACTION ITEMS:
- aj: push HS workflow + add handoff_sla_minutes property (done)
- devon: add SF assignment rule + connector mapping (in progress)
- sam: run enrichment reattempt + postmortem (in progress)
- maria: update Playbook with SLA language and reporting requirements (todo)

Notes: keep an eye on duplicates for the next 2 hours after workflow change. If you spot misassigned leads, add a comment in the test lead and ping @aj.
